name: Flesh to Wood
body:
School transmutation [wood]; Level bloodlord 6, druid 6, shaman 6, witch 6

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (wood chisel)

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Target one creature

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

Wood: Spells with this descriptor include those that directly create, utilize, or manipulate plant or wood in some manner or conjure creatures with the plant subtype or composed of wood. Such spells are considered to belong to the Wood element (for geomancers) and the Wood elemental school (for wood elementalists).

The subject, along with all its carried gear, turns into a mindless, inert, wooden statue. If the statue resulting from this spell is broken or damaged, the subject (if ever returned to its original state) has similar damage or deformities. The creature is not dead, but it does not seem to be alive either when viewed with spells such as deathwatch.

Only creatures made of flesh are affected by this spell.
